name: Tushen Lissafin Kuɗin Asibiti da Rubuta Lambobin Lafiya (Medical Billing and Coding)
objectives: Ta amfani da shafukan hukuma na NHA, AAPC da AHIMA, kwatanta takardun shaida uku na billing da coding da rubuta tsarin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku, an duba sharuɗɗan a shafin hukuma, ba a yi hasashe ba
Idan aka ba ku matakan ziyarar likita ba bisa tsari ba, jera matakan zagayen lissafin kuɗi bisa tsari, daga sa lokacin ganin likita zuwa biya, ba tare da wani mataki ya ɓace ba

Idan aka ba ku sassa biyar na ziyara ƙirƙirarriya, haɗa kowane sashe da rukunin lambobi da ya dace: ICD-10-CM don cutar, CPT don aikin likita, HCPCS Level II don kayayyaki, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai

Idan aka ba ku cuta daga rubutun ziyara ƙirƙirarre, neman lambar cuta ta hanyar samun kalmar a cikin index sannan tabbatar da ita a jerin lambobi, kowane lokaci, ba tare da taɓa rubuta lamba daga index kaɗai ba

Idan aka ba ku ziyara ƙirƙirarriya da fom ɗin claim na atisaye marar komai, cike manyan akwatunan claim da gano dalilin da yasa aka ƙi biyan claim na atisaye, mara lafiya, inshora, lambobi da kuɗaɗe sun yi daidai da ziyarar
A yanayoyin atisaye na wurin aiki, raba bayanan mara lafiya ga mutanen da suke buƙatarsu kaɗai, kuma mafi ƙarancin abin da suke buƙata kawai, a kowane yanayi, bisa dokar HIPAA

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Aikin, takardun shaida da lambobi

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Aikin da takardun shaidar da masu ɗaukar aiki suke nema
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Kwatanta takardun shaida uku na billing da coding ku zaɓi ɗaya da za ku nema.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da shafukan hukuma na NHA, AAPC da AHIMA, za ku iya kwatanta takardun shaida uku na billing da coding da rubuta tsarin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku, an duba sharuɗɗan a shafin hukuma, ba a yi hasashe ba.
Mai coding (medical coder) yana karanta rubutun likita ya mayar da cutar da ayyukan da aka yi zuwa lambobi. Mai billing (medical biller) yana amfani da waɗannan lambobi don aika claim zuwa kamfanin inshora, kuma yana bin sa har a biya. A ƙananan ofisoshi, sau da yawa mutum ɗaya ne yake yin duka biyun.
Masu ɗaukar aiki sau da yawa suna neman takardar shaida. Guda uku da aka saba gani: Certified Billing and Coding Specialist (CBCS) daga NHA, wato National Healthcareer Association; Certified Professional Coder (CPC) daga AAPC; da Certified Coding Associate (CCA) daga AHIMA, wato American Health Information Management Association.
Kowacce tana da nata ƙa'idoji. Misali, CBCS na NHA yana neman takardar kammala sakandare ko GED, tare da shirin horo ko ƙwarewar aiki ƙarƙashin kulawa. Kuɗi, ƙa'idojin jarabawa da sharuɗɗa suna canjawa, don haka ku karanta shafin hukuma na kowacce kafin ku biya komai. Wannan kwas yana shirya ku; ba ya ba ku takardar shaida.
Ku yi hankali da shirye-shiryen da ke alƙawarin aiki ko takardar shaida cikin 'yan kwanaki. Ku tambayi kowace makaranta wace jarabawar takardar shaida take shirya ku don ita, sannan ku duba wannan jarabawar a shafin hukuma.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe shafin hukuma na CBCS (nhanow.com), CPC (aapc.com) da CCA (ahima.org).
- Ga kowacce, ku rubuta wanda yake bayarwa, abin da kuke buƙata kafin jarabawa, da yadda ake yin jarabawar.
- Ku duba tallace-tallacen neman ma'aikata kusa da ku, ku ƙirga wace takardar shaida suka fi nema.
- Ku zaɓi ɗaya da za ku nema, ku rubuta watan da kuke son yin jarabawar.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Mai coding (medical coder): mutumin da ke mayar da rubutun likita zuwa lambobi na ƙa'ida.
- Mai billing (medical biller): mutumin da ke aika claim ga kamfanonin inshora yana bin su har a biya.
- Takardar shaida (certification): shaida daga ƙungiyar jarabawa cewa kun ci jarabawarta; ana kuma kiranta credential.
- Claim: takardar neman biya da ake aika wa kamfanin inshora don ya biya kuɗin ziyara.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- NHA: Certified Billing and Coding Specialist (CBCS)
- AAPC: Certified Professional Coder (CPC)
- AHIMA: Certified Coding Associate (CCA)
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi tebur mai ginshiƙai uku a takarda ko a spreadsheet: CBCS, CPC, CCA. Ga kowacce, ku rubuta wanda yake bayarwa da abin da kuke buƙata kafin jarabawa, daga shafin hukuma. Sannan ku duba tallace-tallacen aiki biyar na yankinku, ku zagaye takardar shaidar da za ku nema.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin abin da masu billing da coding suke yi, ambaci takardun shaida uku da waɗanda suke bayar da su, da zaɓar ɗaya da za ku nema.

check.q: Wane ne yake bayar da takardar shaidar CPC?
check.why: Certified Professional Coder (CPC) takardar shaida ce ta AAPC.

check.q: Wani shafin intanet ya ce za ku zama mai coding mai takardar shaida cikin kwana uku da ɗan kuɗi kaɗan. Me za ku fara yi?
options: Ku biya da sauri kafin farashi ya hau
Ku faɗa wa masu ɗaukar aiki cewa kuna da takardar shaida
Ku duba ƙa'idojin ainihin jarabawar a shafin hukuma
Ku bar horo; shafin ya isa
check.why: Ƙungiyar da ke bayar da takardar shaidar ce kaɗai za ta iya faɗa muku ainihin ƙa'idojinta da jarabawarta.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Yadda lissafin kuɗi yake tafiya: zagayen billing
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Jera matakan zagayen lissafin kuɗi bisa tsari, daga sa lokaci zuwa biya.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku matakan ziyarar likita ba bisa tsari ba, za ku iya jera matakan zagayen lissafin kuɗi bisa tsari, daga sa lokacin ganin likita zuwa biya, ba tare da wani mataki ya ɓace ba.
Zagayen lissafin kuɗi (billing cycle), wanda ake kuma kira revenue cycle, shi ne hanya daga lokacin da mara lafiya ya sa lokacin ganin likita har zuwa lokacin da aka biya ofishin gaba ɗaya.
Manyan matakai: 1) A sa lokacin ziyara a duba inshora. 2) A karɓi mara lafiya (check-in): a tabbatar da sunansa, ranar haihuwarsa da katin inshorarsa. 3) Likita ya ga mara lafiya ya rubuta bayani. 4) Mai coding ya mayar da bayanin zuwa lambobi. 5) Mai billing ya yi claim ya duba shi. 6) A aika claim ga kamfanin inshora. 7) Kamfanin inshora ya biya, ko ya biya wani ɓangare, ko ya ƙi, ya kuma aiko da bayani. 8) Ofishin ya karɓi kuɗin da mara lafiya ke bi, kamar copay, ya kuma bi duk abin da ba a biya ba.
Kurakurai a farkon zagaye suna kawo matsala daga baya. Lambar inshora da aka rubuta ba daidai ba a lokacin check-in tana iya sa a ƙi claim bayan makonni. Shi yasa check-in a hankali yake da muhimmanci kamar coding a hankali.
Mataki-mataki:
- A sa lokaci a duba inshora.
- A karɓi mara lafiya a tabbatar da bayanansa.
- Likita ya ga mara lafiya ya rubuta bayani.
- A yi coding na ziyarar.
- A yi claim a duba shi.
- A aika claim.
- A karanta biyan ko ƙin biyan.
- A karɓi kason mara lafiya a bi abin da ya rage.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Zagayen billing (revenue cycle): dukkan matakai daga sa lokacin ziyara har zuwa an biya gaba ɗaya.
- Copay: ƙayyadadden kuɗi da mara lafiya yake biya don ziyara.
- Deductible: kuɗin da mara lafiya yake biya kowace shekara kafin inshora ta fara biyan ayyuka da yawa.
- Mai biya (payer): kamfanin inshora ko shirin gwamnati da ke biyan claim.
- Ƙin biya (denial): lokacin da mai biya ya ƙi biyan claim.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta matakai takwas na zagayen billing a ƙananan takardu takwas. Ku cakuɗa su, sannan ku sake jera su bisa tsari ba tare da kallo ba. Kusa da kowane mataki, ku rubuta kuskure ɗaya da zai iya faruwa a wurin, misali suna da aka rubuta ba daidai ba a lokacin check-in.
Yanzu za ku iya jera matakan zagayen billing bisa tsari, da faɗin yadda kuskuren farko zai iya kawo ƙin biya daga baya.

check.q: Wane mataki ne yake zuwa nan take bayan mai coding ya mayar da bayani zuwa lambobi?
options: Mai biya ya aiko da biya
Mai billing ya yi claim ya duba shi
check.why: Coding yana zuwa da farko; sannan mai billing ya yi claim daga waɗannan lambobi ya duba shi.

check.q: A lokacin check-in, an rubuta lambar inshorar mara lafiya ba daidai ba. Mene ne mafi yiwuwar sakamako?
options: Ana iya ƙin claim daga baya
Babu komai; mai coding zai gani
Za a biya likita da sauri
Copay ɗin mara lafiya zai ragu
check.why: Mai biya yana kwatanta claim da bayanan membobinsa; lambar da ba daidai ba sau da yawa tana kawo ƙin biya.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Rukunonin lambobi uku
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Haɗa kowane sashe na ziyara da rukunin lambobi da ya dace.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku sassa biyar na ziyara ƙirƙirarriya, za ku iya haɗa kowane sashe da rukunin lambobi da ya dace: ICD-10-CM don cutar, CPT don aikin likita, HCPCS Level II don kayayyaki, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai.
Claim yana amsa tambayoyi biyu: me yasa mara lafiya ya zo, kuma me ofishin ya yi? Rukunonin lambobi daban-daban ne suke amsa kowacce.
Lambobin ICD-10-CM suna faɗin ME YASA: cutar, alamarta ko abin da mara lafiya yake ji. Suna farawa da harafi, sannan lambobi, kuma wani lokaci suna da digo, misali I10 don hawan jini da ba a san dalilinsa ba (misalin atisaye). A Amurka, cibiyar National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) ta CDC ce ke kula da ICD-10-CM.
Lambobin CPT suna faɗin ME likita ko wani ƙwararre ya yi: ziyarar ofis, gwajin lab, ko wani aiki (procedure). Lambobi biyar ne, misali 36415 don ɗiban jini daga jijiya (misalin atisaye). American Medical Association (AMA) ce ta mallaki CPT kuma take sabunta shi. CMS tana kiran CPT "HCPCS Level I".
Lambobin HCPCS Level II suna rufe abubuwan da CPT ba ya rufewa, kamar kayayyaki, na'urori da motar asibiti (ambulance). Harafi ɗaya ne da lambobi huɗu. CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) ce ke kula da su. Ana sabunta dukkan rukunonin lambobi kowace shekara, don haka koyaushe ku yi amfani da littafi ko kayan aiki na yanzu.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Cuta (diagnosis): matsalar lafiya da likita ya gano ko yake magani.
- ICD-10-CM: rukunin lambobi na cututtuka a Amurka.
- CPT: rukunin lambobi biyar na AMA don ayyuka da procedure; ana kuma kiransa HCPCS Level I.
- HCPCS Level II: rukunin lambobi na CMS don kayayyaki, na'urori da sauran abubuwan da CPT ba ya rufewa; harafi ɗaya da lambobi huɗu.
- CMS: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, hukumar gwamnatin tarayya ta Amurka da ke gudanar da Medicare kuma take aiki da jihohi kan Medicaid.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- CDC NCHS: ICD-10-CM
- CMS: HCPCS (Level I is CPT, Level II is kept by CMS)
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye kawai. Ga wannan ziyara ƙirƙirarriya, ku rubuta rukunin lambobi na kowane sashe: (1) ciwon maƙogwaro, (2) ziyarar ofis wurin likita, (3) gwajin strep na gaggawa, (4) hawan jini, (5) sandunan guragu (crutches) guda biyu da mara lafiya ya tafi da su gida. Amsoshi: 1 da 4 ICD-10-CM ne, 2 da 3 CPT ne, 5 HCPCS Level II ne.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin wane rukunin lambobi ne yake amsa me yasa mara lafiya ya zo da wanda yake amsa me aka yi, da haɗa sassan ziyara da ICD-10-CM, CPT ko HCPCS Level II.

check.q: Wane rukunin lambobi kuke amfani da shi don cutar mara lafiya?
check.why: Lambobin ICD-10-CM suna faɗin me yasa mara lafiya ya zo: cutar, alamarta ko abin da yake ji.

check.q: Mara lafiya ya tafi gida da sandar tafiya mai ƙafafu (walker). Wane rukunin lambobi ne yawanci yake rufe walker?
check.why: Na'urori da kayayyakin da CPT ba ya rufewa suna amfani da lambobin HCPCS Level II.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Lambobi, claim da sirri

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Neman lamba ta hanyar da ta dace
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Neman lambar cuta a cikin index da tabbatar da ita a jerin lambobi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku cuta daga rubutun ziyara ƙirƙirarre, za ku iya neman lambar cuta ta hanyar samun kalmar a cikin index sannan tabbatar da ita a jerin lambobi, kowane lokaci, ba tare da taɓa rubuta lamba daga index kaɗai ba.
ICD-10-CM yana da manyan sassa biyu. Alphabetic index (jerin haruffa) yana jera cututtuka da sunansu, kamar index na littafi. Tabular list (jerin lambobi) yana nuna kowace lamba bisa tsari, tare da bayanin lokacin da za a yi amfani da ita da lokacin da ba za a yi ba.
Ƙa'idar da masu coding suke bi: ku fara samun babbar kalma a cikin index, sannan koyaushe ku tabbatar da lambar a tabular list. Kada ku taɓa rubuta lamba daga index kaɗai, domin tabular list yana iya cewa a ƙara harafi ko lamba, ko a yi amfani da wata lambar daban.
Ku nemi cutar, ba sashen jiki ba. Don "acute sore throat" (ciwon maƙogwaro mai tsanani), babbar kalmar ita ce pharyngitis (kalmar likitanci don maƙogwaro mai ciwo da kumburi). Sannan ku karanta bayanai a tabular list kafin ku zaɓi lambar. CPT ma yana da nasa index da jerin lambobi, kuma yana aiki haka.
Atisaye kyauta: ICD-10-CM Browser Tool na CDC yana ba ku damar bincika rukunin lambobin a intanet. A aiki na gaske, kuna amfani da littafin lambobi na yanzu ko kayan aikin da mai ɗaukar ku aiki ya biya, tare da rubutun likita, ba hasashe ba.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku karanta rubutun likita ku nemo cutar.
- Ku nemo babbar kalmar cutar a cikin alphabetic index.
- Ku rubuta lambar da index ya nuna.
- Ku je wannan lambar a tabular list.
- Ku karanta bayanan: "includes", "excludes", da ko ana buƙatar ƙarin haruffa ko lambobi.
- Ku zaɓi lambar da ta yi daidai da rubutun likita sosai.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Alphabetic index: sashen littafin lambobi da ke jera cututtuka da sunansu, daga A zuwa Z.
- Tabular list: sashen littafin lambobi da ke jera kowace lamba bisa tsari, tare da ƙa'idojin amfani da ita.
- Babbar kalma (main term): kalmar cutar da kuke fara nema, ba sashen jiki ba.
- Cikakken bayani (specificity): yadda lamba take daidai sosai; masu coding suna amfani da lambar da ta fi daidai wadda rubutun likita ya goyi baya.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- CDC NCHS: ICD-10-CM and the ICD-10-CM Browser Tool
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye kawai. Ku buɗe ICD-10-CM Browser Tool na CDC daga hanyar haɗin majiya. Ku nemi waɗannan cututtuka ƙirƙirarru: "acute pharyngitis", "essential hypertension" da "type 2 diabetes without complications". Ga kowacce, ku rubuta babbar kalmar da kuka bincika, lambar da kuka samu, da bayani ɗaya da kuka karanta kafin ku zaɓe ta.
Yanzu za ku iya neman lambar cuta a matakai biyu, index sannan tabular list, da faɗin dalilin da yasa ba za ku taɓa tsayawa a index ba.

check.q: Kun sami lamba a cikin alphabetic index. Me za ku yi a gaba?
options: Ku saka ta a claim nan take
Ku tabbatar da ita a tabular list ku karanta bayananta
Ku tambayi mara lafiya ko ta yi kama da daidai
Ku zaɓi gajeriyar lambar da ke kusa
check.why: Tabular list yana da ƙa'idoji kuma yana iya buƙatar ƙarin haruffa ko lambobi; kada ku taɓa yin coding daga index kaɗai.

check.q: Rubutun likita ya ce "acute bronchitis". Wace ce babbar kalmar da za ku nema?
check.why: Kuna neman cutar (bronchitis), sannan ku nemo "acute" a ƙarƙashinta.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Cike claim da gyara ƙin biya
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Cike manyan akwatunan claim 1500 na atisaye da gano dalilin da yasa aka ƙi claim.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku ziyara ƙirƙirarriya da fom ɗin claim na atisaye marar komai, za ku iya cike manyan akwatunan claim da gano dalilin da yasa aka ƙi biyan claim na atisaye, mara lafiya, inshora, lambobi da kuɗaɗe sun yi daidai da ziyarar.
Ofisoshin likitoci suna neman biya da fom ɗin claim 1500, wanda National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) take kula da shi. Nau'in takarda da ake amfani da shi shi ne fom na 02/12. Yawancin claim a yau ta intanet ake aika su, amma claim na intanet yana da bayanai iri ɗaya, don haka koyon fom na takarda yana koya muku bayanan.
Manyan akwatuna da za ku sani (atisaye): Akwati 1a, lambar shaidar mai inshora (insured's ID) daga katin inshora. Akwati 2, sunan mara lafiya. Akwati 21, lambobin cuta, masu alamar A, B, C da sauransu. Akwati 24, layukan ayyuka: ranar aikin (24A), lambar CPT ko HCPCS (24D), diagnosis pointer da ke haɗa aikin da harafin cuta a Akwati 21 (24E), da kuɗin (24F). Akwati 33, mai bayar da sabis da ke neman biya (billing provider).
Kafin claim ya tafi, ku duba shi: mara lafiya da lambar shaida daidai ne, kowane aiki yana da diagnosis pointer, lambobi na yanzu ne, ranaku da kuɗaɗe sun yi daidai da ziyarar. Kama kurakurai yanzu ya fi sauƙi da arha fiye da gyara ƙin biya daga baya.
Idan aka ƙi claim, mai biya yana aiko da remittance (bayanin biya) tare da dalili. Dalilan da aka saba gani: lambar shaida ko suna ba daidai ba, lamba ta ɓace ko ba ta aiki, aikin ba a rufe shi a inshora ba, babu izini kafin aiki (prior authorization), claim da aka aika sau biyu, ko an aika a makare. Ku nemo dalilin, ku gyara shi, sannan ku sake aikawa ko ku ɗaukaka ƙara bisa ƙa'idojin mai biya.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku kwafi lambar shaidar mai inshora (1a) da sunan mara lafiya (2) daidai daga katin ƙirƙirarre.
- Ku rubuta lambobin cuta a Akwati 21 a matsayin A, B, C.
- A kowane layin aiki a Akwati 24, ku rubuta ranar, lambar CPT ko HCPCS, diagnosis pointer da kuɗin.
- Ku cike mai bayar da sabis da ke neman biya (33).
- Ku duba claim ɗin da jerin bincikenku kafin aikawa.
- Idan aka ƙi shi, ku karanta dalilin, ku gyara abin da ya jawo, ku sake aikawa bisa ƙa'idojin mai biya.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Fom ɗin claim 1500: fom na takarda na ƙa'ida don claim na ofisoshin likitoci, wanda NUCC take kula da shi.
- Diagnosis pointer: harafin da ke kan layin aiki (A, B, C) da ke haɗa shi da wata cuta a Akwati 21.
- Remittance (EOB ko ERA): bayanin mai biya na abin da ya biya ko ya ƙi, da dalili.
- Prior authorization: izini daga mai biya kafin a yi wasu ayyuka.
- Claim mai tsafta (clean claim): claim marar kuskure, ta yadda za a biya shi a karon farko.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- NUCC: 1500 Claim Form
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye kawai. Mara lafiya ƙirƙirarre: Sam Rivera, lambar shaidar mai inshora ABC123456. Ziyara a ranar da kuka zaɓa: ziyarar ofis (99213) don ciwon maƙogwaro (J02.9) tare da gwajin strep na gaggawa (87880), kuɗi $100 da $25 (ƙirƙirarru). A takarda ko a spreadsheet, ku cike Akwatuna 1a, 2, 21, 24 (layuka biyu) da 33 ("Practice Clinic"). Sannan claim ɗin ya dawo: "invalid member ID" (lambar membobi ba ta aiki). Ku rubuta abin da za ku duba ku gyara.
Yanzu za ku iya cike manyan akwatunan claim na atisaye, duba shi kafin ya tafi, da ganowa da gyara dalilin ƙin biya.

check.q: A ina lambobin cuta suke zuwa a fom 1500?
check.why: Akwati 21 yana ɗauke da lambobin cuta, masu alamar A, B, C da sauransu.

check.q: An ƙi claim da cewa "service requires prior authorization" (aikin yana buƙatar izini kafin a yi). Me ya ɓace?
options: Sa hannun likita a fayil na takarda
check.why: Prior authorization izinin mai biya ne kafin wasu ayyuka; idan babu shi, ana ƙin claim.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Kare sirrin mara lafiya, da claim ɗinku na atisaye
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Raba bayanan mara lafiya ga waɗanda suke buƙatarsu kaɗai, kuma abin da suke buƙata kawai.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A yanayoyin atisaye na wurin aiki, za ku iya raba bayanan mara lafiya ga mutanen da suke buƙatarsu kaɗai, kuma mafi ƙarancin abin da suke buƙata kawai, a kowane yanayi, bisa dokar HIPAA.
Masu billing da coding suna ganin bayanan lafiya na sirri kowace rana: sunaye, ranakun haihuwa, cututtuka, lambobin inshora. HIPAA dokar gwamnatin tarayya ta Amurka ce da ke kare su. Ƙa'idarta ta sirri (Privacy Rule) tana rufe shirye-shiryen inshorar lafiya, yawancin ofisoshin likitoci da asibitoci, da kamfanonin da ke aiki musu, kamar kamfanonin billing.
Protected health information (PHI) duk wani bayanin lafiya ne da zai iya nuna ko wane ne mutum. Ƙa'idar "minimum necessary" (mafi ƙarancin abin da ake buƙata) tana nufin ku yi amfani da kuma raba abin da ake buƙata don aikin kawai. Mai biya yana iya buƙatar lambar cuta a kan claim; abokin aiki a ɗakin hutu ba ya buƙatar jin ta.
Al'adun yau da kullum: ku kulle allonku idan za ku tashi, kada ku taɓa magana game da marasa lafiya a bainar jama'a, ku tabbatar da ko wane ne duk wanda ya kira, ku aika claim ta tsarin da aka amince da shi kaɗai, kuma kada ku taɓa tura PHI ta imel ko tes daga asusunku na kanku. Idan kun ga kuskuren sirri, ku faɗa wa shugabanku ko jami'in sirri (privacy officer) nan take.
Yanzu ku haɗa komai a aikinku na ƙarshe: cikakken claim na atisaye da tsarin takardar shaidarku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Kafin ku raba, ku tambayi: shin wannan mutumin yana da dalilin aiki na sani?
- Ku raba mafi ƙarancin abin da yake buƙata kawai.
- Ku tabbatar da ko wane ne yake kira kafin ku bayar da komai.
- Ku kulle allonku ku yi amfani da tsarin da aka amince da shi kaɗai.
- Ku kai rahoton kurakuran sirri ga shugabanku ko jami'in sirri.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- HIPAA: dokar gwamnatin tarayya ta Amurka da ke kare sirri da tsaron bayanan lafiya.
- PHI: protected health information: bayanin lafiya da zai iya nuna ko wane ne mutum.
- Minimum necessary: ra'ayin HIPAA na amfani ko raba bayanan da ake buƙata don aikin kawai.
- Jami'in sirri (privacy officer): mutumin da ke kula da ƙa'idojin sirri da rahotanni a wurin aiki.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- HHS: HIPAA for professionals (Privacy Rule)
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe, atisaye kawai. Ziyara ƙirƙirarriya: Ana Lee, lambar shaidar mai inshora XYZ987654, ta ga likita (99213) saboda hawan jini (I10) kuma an ɗibi jininta daga jijiya (36415); kuɗi ƙirƙirarru $100 da $15. Ku cike claim 1500 na atisaye (Akwatuna 1a, 2, 21, 24, 33), ku duba shi da jerin bincike da kuka rubuta da kanku kafin aikawa, sannan ku ƙara tsari mai shafi ɗaya: takardar shaidarku, inda za ku yi horo, da ranar da kuke son yin jarabawa. Kada ku yi amfani da bayanan mara lafiya na gaske.
Yanzu za ku iya kare bayanan mara lafiya da ƙa'idar minimum necessary, da mayar da ziyara ƙirƙirarriya zuwa cikakken claim na atisaye da aka duba.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Tsarin takardar shaida Ba a ambaci takardar shaida ba, ko an yi hasashen sharuɗɗa maimakon a duba su. Ya ambaci takardar shaida ɗaya da wanda yake bayar da ita, tare da sharuɗɗa da ranar jarabawa da aka ɗauko daga shafin hukuma. Ya kuma jera shirin horo, ranakun karatu na kowane mako, da abin da tallace-tallacen aiki na yankin suke nema. Rukunonin lambobi daidai An yi coding na cuta da CPT, ko na aiki da ICD-10-CM. Cutar tana amfani da ICD-10-CM, kowane aiki kuma yana amfani da CPT. Zai iya bayyana dalilin da yasa kowace lamba take cikin rukunin lambobinta. An nemi lambobi ta hanyar da ta dace An kwafi lambobi ba tare da dubawa ba, ko an ɗauko su daga index kaɗai. An sami kowace cuta a cikin index aka tabbatar da ita a tabular list (ko kayan aikin CDC). Ya rubuta babbar kalmar da aka bincika da ƙa'ida ɗaya da aka karanta ga kowace lamba. An cike akwatunan claim Akwai akwatunan da suka ɓace, ko lambar shaida, lambobi ko kuɗaɗe ba su yi daidai da ziyarar ba. An cike Akwatuna 1a, 2, 21, 24 da 33 kuma sun yi daidai da ziyarar; kowane layin aiki yana da pointer. Ya haɗa da rubutaccen jerin bincike kafin aikawa da ke kama aƙalla kuskure ɗaya da aka saka da gangan. Zagayen billing da bin diddigi Ba zai iya faɗin abin da ke faruwa bayan an aika claim ba. Ya faɗi matakai daga aikawa zuwa biya, da abin da za a yi idan aka ƙi shi. Ya ambaci dalilai biyu na ƙin biya da gyaran kowanne. An kiyaye sirri Ya yi amfani da bayanan mara lafiya na gaske, ko ya raba PHI ga wanda ba ya buƙata. Ya yi amfani da bayanai ƙirƙirarru kawai kuma ya kiyaye claim ɗin a sirri. Ya jera al'adu uku na yau da kullum da ke kare PHI a wurin aiki. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.
